title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
synopsis: The life of the Vikings clan on the island of Oluh has changed drastically. Now they are dragon riders, every resident here has their own dragon and each has more than one. This is all thanks to Igking, who lost a leg but transformed his village. Stoik insists that he must take the position of chief, but Igking does not want this; all he dreams of is flying on Toothless and exploring uncharted territories. Yet even his beloved Astrid assures him that he must accept his father's proposal. But soon they will face a new challenge, as not all Viking clans support Oluh's ideology, particularly Drago Bloodfist, who believes the purpose of life is to exterminate all dragons. He plans to attack Oluh. Igking tries to resolve everything peacefully, but this leads to Stoik's death, although in return, he finds his long-lost mother Valky alive, and moreover, she is now the protector of dragons. Igking and Valky will have to find a way to stop Bloodfist, as he knows how to bend dragons to his will with the help of a giant dragon leader.
